title: Mixed Event — Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show! — Episode8 Big Dreams Beneath My Pillow

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!
meta.Episode: Episode8 — Big Dreams Beneath My Pillow
meta.Event Outline: After successfully wrapping up their ambassadorial performances, Wonderlands×Showtime is preparing to put on a New Year's show at the new and improved Wonder Stage. Unfortunately, Lion Dance Robot seems to be feeling a bit under the weather...

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here's to our successful New Year's performances...! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui & Nene
rows.Line:
Cheers!
Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, Lion Dance Robot, here's some fresh oil. I know it was a tough schedule, so thank you both for persevering.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was amazed to hear that, aside from the Wonder Stage, you were able to put on shows in 4 other places.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too! That's what I call a dynamic plan!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still, are you guys okay?
Don't you feel tired at all?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be honest, I wasn't sure we'd make it through when I first heard about what we'd be doing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I think we were able to pull it off because it ended up being more fun than expected.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
The guests at the Wonder Stage also really loved it—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh nooo!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do I do?! I slept so well yesterday that I didn't have my first dream!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your first dream...? Oh, of the new year?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's the case, won't the dream you see tonight count as your first for this year?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, that counts?!
Then, I'm gonna have a super wonderhoy dream tonight!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A wonderhoy dream... What does that entail?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh, soo... You guys are all gonna be in it, including Miku and everyone...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we'll put on lots and lots of shows in all sorts of different places like yesterday♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's very similar to what we just experienced in real life, but it sounds like a wonderful first dream...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I wanna see that dream too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, let's draw it together!
I heard that if you draw what you want to dream and put it under your pillow, you'll actually see it when you sleep!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? That sounds like fun♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if we got a big sheet of paper for that?! We could all draw on it and sleep on it afterward!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that means we'll all get to see the same dream♪ Where can we find a sheet of paper like that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'll help you guys look for one!
Nene, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? W-Wait...!
You don't need to pull me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I guess we'll be sleeping directly on top of it instead of putting it under a pillow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That'll be very interesting to see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Tsukasa?
You're usually all wound up and ready to go in these situations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, I'm fine...
I was just reminiscing over what happened yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes.
Asking for volunteers from the audience ended up being an interesting learning experience...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Ichika and the others sang in a way that felt so encouraging. That sort of singing performance is sure to invigorate any audience she sings for.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hanasato and her group also put on a wonderful performance. Based on how well they interacted with that audience, their shows must be out of this world...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't forget Shiraishi and her teammate! I was so moved by the way they sang with so much passion! They certainly know how to please an audience.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(That girl... Yoisaki, was it?
I was completely staggered by how she was able to come up with such a beautiful song on the spot.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A show requires more than just actors. Everyone, including those involved with sound production, must work together to bring it to life.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Moving forward, I'd like to work more on understanding what kind of music would suit certain scenes better.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I have quite a bit to work on in the future...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it was a wonderful learning experience!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It was?!
Then, I'm glad☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It was as I suspected...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was able to make these realizations because I performed with different people at places we normally don't.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means I can't let things just be...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Something on the order of our ambassadorial performances may not be possible, but I need to start by asking to perform elsewhere.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However, this is not something I can decide on my own. I'll need to speak with Emu's brothers first.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I must do this! For the sake of my dream!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone! We found a giant sheet of paper!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's all draw on it and have ourselves a little nap!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's draw♪
Oh, but what?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh?
You wanna draw too?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Having put on a series of successful shows, he seems to be rather motivated.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...!
That's great to hear!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Lion Dance Robot, let us keep putting on wonderful shows together moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line:
CHOMP...!
CHOMP...

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP... CHOMP CHOMP...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
He appears to be very excited.
So excited that he may overheat soon...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, which means he may once again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! That can only mean...

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nooo!
He's coming after me again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Is Tsukasa gonna be okay?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... He's designed to operate on his own, but it's interesting how he always chases after Tsukasa... I'll need to take a closer look at some point...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha! He does look excited!
Let's play a game of tag before we draw♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now is not the time for that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uhh, Rui...?
Shouldn't you do something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know.
We wouldn't want our valiant troupe leader to get hurt. Emu, would you mind lending me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's go save Tsukasa together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I see another fun and exciting year in the works.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup☆
I can't wait to see what happens!
